title: Andrew Schulz Violates Logan Paul & City Of Cleveland On Monday Night Raw On Netflix [Watch]
htmlContent:
This week's WWE Raw at Madison Square Garden was a popular event. CM Punk and Seth Rollins faced off in a steel cage. Stand-up comedian Andrew Schulz, seated in the front row, was among the major stars who came to the historic venue.

AJ Styles Calls Out Logan Paul – But Gets Interrupted

AJ Styles' promise to call out Logan Paul was one of the biggest storylines of the night. Paul, a natural in the ring, has accepted his role as an arrogant and egotistical performer, which has left WWE fans unhappy. Paul took charge of the moment by coming out first and cutting a promo that claimed to be the reason why celebrities attend WWE events before Styles could make his entrance. https://youtube.com/shorts/gOZWVhgfcaM?si=mgAX1pVn0X3MohCU

Logan Paul Confronts Andrew Schulz at Ringside

Paul proceeded to the ringside, meeting with comedian Andrew Schulz, who had once interviewed him on his podcast. Paul questioned why he came to MSG, expecting Schulz to boost his self-esteem. Schulz did not give him the answer he was looking for.

“Logan, nobody is here to see you... You are not in Cleveland, Ohio, buddy. This is New York City. This is a real city, a real arena, and we like real wrestlers. I know who I want to see. I want to see AJ Styles.”

Paul was not pleased with this response, so he retaliated by pulling Schulz from the crowd and taking him into the ring. He set up the comedian for a suplex, but before he could execute the move, AJ Styles rushed out to make the save.

AJ Styles Takes Down Logan Paul

Paul was immediately attacked by Styles, who threw a flurry of punches and elbows before landing a Phenomenal Forearm. The MSG crowd erupted as Styles and Schulz celebrated in the ring, while Paul retreated to the back.

What’s Next for Logan Paul and AJ Styles?

The confrontation at Madison Square Garden further fuels speculation about an eventual showdown between Styles and Paul, possibly at WrestleMania 41. Paul started his WWE journey as an outsider but has since shown himself to be a talented performer in the ring. A high-profile match against one of the greatest professional wrestlers, AJ Styles, would only enhance his credibility and confirm his status as a genuine WWE superstar. All eyes will be on WWE's next moves as tensions mount before WrestleMania 41. Will Styles and Paul resolve their differences on the biggest stage of all? Fans must wait and see what happens.
